name: Veteran Soldier: Floating Memory pays a champion level-up's memory cost from graveyard
notes: Same Floating Memory keyword and same test shape as shieldroid-floating-memory / stalwart-shieldmate-floating-memory / honorable-vanguard-floating-memory / return-stroke-floating-memory -- Veteran Soldier's only ability (abilityCount=1 in the semantic backlog) is this unconditional keyword (while paying a memory cost, you may banish this card from your graveyard to pay for 1 of that cost). Pay Lorraine, Wandering Warrior's 1-memory champion level-up cost entirely from a Veteran Soldier seeded directly into the graveyard, with no myMemory filler seeded, so QueueMaterializeFloatingPaymentChoice (GrandArchiveSim/Custom/MaterializeLogic.php) offers it as the sole payment source.

rulesClauses: Floating Memory (While paying for a memory cost, you may banish this card from your graveyard to pay for 1 of that cost.)
